propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the outbound comment differ computes local and Jira-side body-equality keys using different decoders: local uses markdown round-trip (which escapes markdown-active characters), while Jira-side uses adf_to_text (which does not escape), causing matched comments to be re-emitted as duplicates.

The send path encodes a decorated body whose HTML comment decoration causes markdown_to_adf to degrade the document to plain text encoding, while the local key round-trips the undecorated body through rich mode, creating a wire-to-key divergence.

The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same decoder used on the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry across all rich_text_cutover settings and comment types.

Markdown comments within the length limit are incorrectly flagged as duplicates and re-emitted when reconciler.rich_text_cutover='cloud' because the dedup keys do not match their actual landed bodies.

The divergence was introduced when the send path moved to codec ADF encoding of the decorated body while the local key routes through flag-governed normalize_outbound, leaving Jira-side decode on normalize_rich_text/adf_to_text.
